title: PLAYER 2 LINKS IN A TEST FRAME
why: coord-06 re-test of v33.59: inside itch frame the player 2 address kept ?netslot, and a window with netslot is never player 2, so a test copy opened with it never linked. The embedded path now drops netslot like p2, mode, pair, arc and emb. Players never have netslot; the top level address is unchanged.
now: A test frame opened with netslot now links its player 2 window; nothing changes for players.

edits.anchor: if(emb){ keep=String((typeof location!=='undefined'&&location.search)||'').replace(/^\?/,'').split('&').filter(function(s){ return s&&!/^(p2|mode|pair|arc|emb)=/.test(s); }).join('&'); if(keep) keep+='&'; }
edits.replacement:
// v33.62 (cw-p2noslot): the embedded copy drops netslot too; a window with ?netslot is never player 2 (NETP2=!NETSLOT&&..., v15.76), so a test frame opened with it never linked. qOver is a test seam for the frame's query.
  if(emb){ keep=String((typeof qOver==='string')?qOver:((typeof location!=='undefined'&&location.search)||'')).replace(/^\?/,'').split('&').filter(function(s){ return s&&!/^(p2|mode|pair|arc|emb|netslot)=/.test(s); }).join('&'); if(keep) keep+='&'; }
